fact_text: A foreign natural person who meets the conditions of Art. 4.1 of the Internal Tax Regime Law (LORTI) is an Ecuadorian fiscal resident and may obtain an SRI fiscal-residency certificate.
evidence_quote: las personas naturales que se encuentren en alguna de las condiciones establecidas en el artículo 4.1 de la Ley de Régimen Tributario Interno

fact_text: A foreign worker's employer must register the hire (worker data and contract terms) in the Ministry of Labour's Sistema Único de Trabajo (SUT); the registration has no cost.
evidence_quote: El empleador deberá registrar las nuevas contrataciones en el Sistema Único de Trabajo SUT e ingresar los datos personales y estipulaciones contractuales de su trabajador

fact_text: Employer-provided medical insurance is NOT required for Employment Pass holders (unlike Work Permit and S Pass holders); an EP holder arranges their own cover.
evidence_quote: Providing medical insurance is not a requirement for employing Employment Pass (EP) holders.

fact_text: Every foreigner working in Singapore (including an EP holder) is issued a unique Foreign Identification Number (FIN) by ICA for identification and registration — the foreigner's equivalent of a citizen ID number.
evidence_quote: FINs are unique identification numbers issued by ICA and government agencies to foreigners who are working, studying, or residing in Singapore.
